note: Liveries of the parked aircraft. The base (the .blend's own colours) is grey body + teal tail, used on the two side planes (Plane_B, Plane_D). Each variant below recolours the listed parts (sRGB hex per material, name without M_Aircraft_) on the same UVs; parts not listed keep the base colour (windows, tyres, dark trim, engine interior). export_fbx.py bakes one T_Prop_Aircraft_<Variant>_Atlas_Albedo per variant; ArtAircraftBuilder.cs puts it on the prefab variant.
